title: Move (and optionally rename) a Claude plugin

name.description: Plugin to move: a folder path (e.g. plugins/payments) or a plugin/marketplace name.
name.x-prompt: Which plugin (folder path or plugin name)?

destination.description: New workspace-relative plugin folder, under plugins/ (e.g. plugins/team-a/payments).
destination.x-prompt: Move to which folder (workspace-relative, under plugins/)?

newName.description: Also rename the plugin (updates plugin.json, the marketplace entry, dependents' dependencies, and plugin:skill references). Default: keep the current name.
